## React / JSX Helper

> For HTML/web contexts only. Do not use in PPTX builds.

```jsx
const APOLLO_PATHS = {
  ray1: "M166.362 110.96L166.312 0.721829C161.444 0.251801 156.492 0 151.507 0C139.371 0 127.571 1.44366 116.257 4.12954L149.862 109.987C151.759 115.946 144.507 120.545 139.925 116.298L53.2608 36.1922C40.9738 46.6671 30.3821 59.0725 21.939 72.9551L132.438 131.407C147.831 139.548 166.362 128.385 166.362 110.96Z",
  ray2: "M136.272 192.56L136.322 302.245C141.324 302.748 146.393 303 151.513 303C163.464 303 175.097 301.607 186.259 298.988L152.772 193.534C150.875 187.575 158.126 182.975 162.709 187.222L249.272 267.228C261.609 256.803 272.251 244.431 280.745 230.599L170.195 172.131C154.803 163.989 136.272 175.153 136.272 192.577V192.56Z",
  ray3: "M186.777 140.371L267.045 53.5167C256.571 41.1785 244.167 30.5357 230.285 22.0752L171.67 132.901C163.529 148.295 174.691 166.827 192.115 166.81L302.245 166.76C302.748 161.741 303 156.654 303 151.501C303 139.515 301.607 127.865 298.972 116.685L193.088 150.309C187.129 152.206 182.53 144.954 186.777 140.371Z",
  ray4: "M110.516 136.711L0.721779 136.761C0.251783 141.612 0 146.531 0 151.5C0 163.62 1.42677 175.387 4.11246 186.685L109.526 153.212C115.485 151.315 120.084 158.567 115.837 163.15L36.005 249.534C46.4457 261.822 58.7998 272.431 72.6311 280.875L130.944 170.62C139.085 155.226 127.923 136.694 110.499 136.694L110.516 136.711Z"
};

const LOGO_VARIANTS = {
  white: "#FFFFFF",
  stone: "#252521",
  apolloSun: "#FBF500"
};

const ApolloSunburst = ({ size = 64, variant = "stone" }) => {
  const fill = LOGO_VARIANTS[variant] || LOGO_VARIANTS.stone;
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 303 303" shapeRendering="geometricPrecision" aria-label="Apollo logo">
      {Object.values(APOLLO_PATHS).map((d, i) => <path key={i} d={d} fill={fill} />)}
    </svg>
  );
};
```

## Logo Size Presets

| Name | Size | Use Case |
|---|---|---|
| tiny | 16px | Footer chrome |
| small | 24px | Top-right slide brand mark |
| medium | 40px | Nav bars, signatures |
| large | 64px | Hero sections |
| xlarge | 128px | Cover slides |
| hero | 256px+ | Full-bleed watermarks |
